entities.name: Perrie
entities.description: A rhox Broker enforcer who is a master tactician and former boxer, judged a contract breaker for balking at a child's punishment.

entities.name: Falco
entities.description: The aven boss of the Brokers who demands absolute adherence to contracts and is stockpiling Halo for a coming war.

entities.name: Kros
entities.description: A flashy leonin Broker solicitor and ranger who accompanies Perrie, rival and inner circle member, able to wipe memories.

entities.name: Rigo
entities.description: A young leonin Broker solicitor in a pinstripe vest with a street network, who teleports Perrie to headquarters.

entities.name: Jolene
entities.description: A short, muscled Riveteer demolitionist forced into being an Obscura agent, who ambushes Perrie and Kros.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: A dragon boss who has noticed the street Halo supply is affected.

entities.name: Krent
entities.description: A maniacal little street brawler that Perrie was sent after.

entities.name: Junash
entities.description: A harried aven who flees the lounge.

entities.name: The orphan boy
entities.description: A child newspaper seller who broke a Broker contract by spying near an Obscura meeting point and is placed with wardens.

entities.name: Yomu
entities.description: A person who told the boy Perrie would hurt him.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: The New Capenna family of solicitors and enforcers who deal in binding contracts.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: The family that owns most of the Mezzio lounges.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: The New Capenna family of demolitionists and builders.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: The family that makes a point of knowing everything and set a trap for the Brokers.

entities.name: Treza
entities.description: A place tied to Ziatora, in front of which Falco orders a contract breaker dumped.

entities.name: Wardens
entities.description: Women in black who run an orphan school and wipe the boy's memory under contract with the Brokers.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A city perched on girders over the old plane, run by the crime families.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The entertainment district of New Capenna with neutral-ish lounges.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The upper-crust district on girders overlooking the city.

entities.name: Nido Sanctuary
entities.description: The Brokers' headquarters at the top of Park Heights where Falco's office stands.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The industrial district with Halo stacks.

entities.name: The old country
entities.description: The ruined old plane beneath New Capenna reached by a manhole and ladder.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A magical substance almost used as currency that the Brokers are hoarding.

entities.name: Amplifier
entities.description: A device in Perrie's ear that whispers Broker orders.

events.summary: Perrie enters a Mezzio lounge to find Krent and is confronted by two Cabaretti bouncers.
events.quote: "If you weren't hassling me, there'd be nothing to disturb your customers about,"

events.summary: The bouncers taunt Perrie as a contract breaker, and he beats both of them.
events.quote: "Good kitty," he says softly to the bouncer on his right with a wink.

events.summary: Rigo finds Perrie in the alley and tells him to stand down and takes him to Nido Sanctuary by teleport.
events.quote: a flash of white light envelops them as Rigo teleports them off to their headquarters.

events.summary: Falco, still undecided on Perrie's contract breaking over a child, gives him a job to retrieve stolen plans.
events.quote: "I haven't made a judgement on the case, yet,"

events.summary: Falco orders Perrie and Kros to retrieve the Halo storage plans from a Riveteer and to leave her alive.
events.quote: Get the plans back. Leave the Riveteer alive.

events.summary: Kros leads Perrie through a manhole and down a ladder to the old country outside New Capenna.
Twenty feral raccoonfolk attack Perrie and Kros, and Perrie beats them back.
events.quote: Twenty furred, snarling, and clearly starving raccoonfolk attack.

events.summary: A wall collapses on Kros and demolition magic cracks the road beneath Perrie.
events.quote: the entire wall he's been using as cover slumps down onto him with a horrifying groan.

events.summary: Perrie corners Jolene in the ruins, and Kros appears alive and reveals she is under an Obscura spell.
Kros learns from Jolene's mind that the Obscura abducted her and set a trap to start a war between the Brokers and Riveteers.
events.quote: "This is all a trap, she's the bait."

events.summary: Perrie decides to report to Falco empty-handed rather than start a war with the Riveteers.
events.quote: "How many lives will I save if I do?"

events.summary: Falco reveals war is coming and offers Perrie a step up into leadership if he abandons his defiance over the boy.
Perrie refuses to harm a child, and Falco instead sends him to see that the boy is protected.
events.quote: I still need you to go see that boy for me.

events.summary: Perrie delivers the boy to wardens who wipe his memory and school him in secret.
events.quote: "He won't remember a thing before today," the warden says.

events.summary: Perrie heads off to a street fight with the Obscura, carrying the boy's cap.
events.quote: Perrie looks down at the cap in his hand thoughtfully.

relations.quote: Perrie's rise through the Brokers has given him more interesting assignments

relations.note: a solicitor in Falco's inner circle
relations.quote: Every Broker is a solicitor, all equal before the law.

relations.note: salutes and declares service to the law
rivals who came up together like annoying siblings
relations.quote: Like a pair of annoying siblings, Kros and Perrie came up in the Brokers together

relations.note: the Obscura set a trap and the Brokers are preparing for conflict
relations.quote: They're trying to knock us back into our place,
He turns around to look at the solicitor.
